output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    # Find the macro-block size: every square block contains exactly one colored cell.
    for b in range(1,n+1):
        if n%b: continue
        m=n//b
        out=[]; good=True
        for br in range(m):
            row=[]
            for bc in range(m):
                vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(br*b,(br+1)*b) for c in range(bc*b,(bc+1)*b) if grid[r][c]!=0]
                if len(vals)!=1: good=False; break
                row.append(vals[0])
            if not good: break
            out.append(row)
        if good: return out
    return grid"}
